summary: Hotdesk kiosk assembly and cross-border docking-station return & replacement for new satellite hire
description:
Issue summary: New hire (satellite office, EU) requires a pre-configured hotdesk kiosk in Building B, level 3, including monitor VESA mount, powered KVM dock, and badge access. The hiring manager shipped a company docking station from the US which arrived but is incompatible with local power plug and EU customs flagged it for import duties; the recruit needs a working docking station on day one and the original dock must be returned to inventory with customs documentation.

Impact: New hire (software engineer) will be unable to join in-person orientation and will be partially remote for first week if not resolved. Moderate productivity and onboarding coordinator time impact.

Environment: Satellite hub — Berlin office (Building B). Asset tags: TBD; shipping tracking: DHL 1234 5678 90 (held at customs). Badge requested through Okta/BadgeOps but building access denied until asset provisioning and visitor registration complete.

Requested outcome: 1) Onsite facilities prepares a hotdesk kiosk with monitor + VESA mount and temporary power adapter; 2) IT provides a region-compatible docking station from local inventory and images it with the standard onboarding image; 3) Arrange return of the US-sent dock with correct customs paperwork and update inventory; 4) Ensure badge access and desk assignment confirmed before new hire arrival.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) New hire added to okta and request created for 'Badge: Building B Level 3'
2) Hiring manager shipped docking-station (US plug). Parcel marked 'gift' but customs held it for duties.
3) Onsite facilities attempted to mount monitor but missing VESA screws and local power adapter.
4) Okta badge provisioning failed because 'location code' mismatched between HR and facilities request.
5) New hire scheduled start date: 2026-03-03 (requires resolution prior to this date).
comments: 2026-03-01 - Aisha Patel: Opened ticket after hiring coordinator escalated — candidate starts 2026-03-03. DHL shows hold at customs. Need inventory check for local spare docks.

2026-03-02 - Jordan Kim: Reached out to #facilities-berlin to confirm VESA kit availability. Also pinged #it-hardware for EU dock stock. Referencing DHL hold: https://dhl.com/track/DHL-1234567890 (internal slack thread #shipments).

2026-03-03 - Facilities on site (Lena M): Found one spare VESA kit and three EU power adapters in storage room 3. No EU Dock in local inventory currently. Suggested overnight courier from London hub if needed.

2026-03-04 - IT (Marcus Ng): Can image a replacement dock at London office and ship overnight to Berlin; requested confirmation for customs invoice wording to avoid additional duties. Question: should we classify return dock as 'company equipment' with commercial invoice?

2026-03-05 - Jordan Kim: Confirmed: use commercial invoice stating 'company-owned equipment for internal use - no sale'. I created RMA and return label for the incoming US parcel to be sent back to equipment ops in SF once customs release is obtained.
2026-03-08 - Hiring manager (Carmen Ortiz): Candidate pushed remote-first for first two days but prefers onsite after. Please prioritize local dock shipment.

2026-03-10 - Jordan Kim: Local hotdesk prepared with VESA mount and temporary EU adapter. London dock left at DHL express and expected 2026-03-11 morning. Updating ticket with final steps for return and inventory update.
2026-03-10 - Aisha Patel: Noted follow-up items: update inventory, confirm customs clearance steps recorded in Confluence, and review badge provisioning workflow for location code mismatch.
investigation_notes: Confirmed DHL parcel (US->DE) is flagged due to 'gift' declaration and missing commercial invoice; customs held for duties. Contacted DHL customs broker to add 'company-owned equipment' documentation.
Okta badge provisioning failed because HR Onboarding form used 'Berlin-HQ' instead of 'Berlin-BuildingB' location code. Facilities and HR to sync on location codes - filing separate change request.

Inventory search: Berlin storage has one VESA kit, three EU power adapters, zero EU docks. London hub has two spare docks (serials LND-038, LND-041). SF equipment ops can accept return once customs release obtained and RMA scanned.
Risk: If customs fees are assessed, finance must approve paying duties. Estimated duty risk: low if classified as company equipment with supporting docs.
Related Slack threads: #facilities-berlin (thread ts: 1645893200), #shipments (thread ts: 1645899800). Related RMA created: RMA-9072.
resolution: Workaround and partial resolution: Onsite facilities assembled the hotdesk kiosk with local VESA kit and provided a temporary EU power adapter so the new hire had a functional workspace on 2026-03-10 morning. IT shipped a replacement EU docking station from London via DHL Express (tracking LON-EXP-778812) to arrive 2026-03-11 AM. Return plan: once the US-sent dock clears customs, facilities will scan serial, attach the RMA-9072 label, and send it to SF equipment ops. Inventory updated: London dock LND-041 allocated to INT-25567; Berlin storage flagged to reorder 2 EU docks. Follow-ups: 1) HR and Facilities to reconcile location codes (see CONFLUENCE-SPACE Onboarding/Locations/Mapping), 2) Finance to confirm process for customs duty claims for company-owned equipment, 3) Facilities to replenish VESA screw kits. Ticket remains open until RMA closed and inventory reconciled.
next_steps: Facilities to complete RMA pickup and mark parcel as returned in inventory once customs release is received
IT to confirm arrival and image the London dock with company onboarding image and validate candidate login
HR to update onboarding form location code template and notify hiring coordinators of the change
Finance to confirm duty payment process if customs charges applied and document in Confluence runbook
